Subject: Access request: SIG & CAIQ on OneTrust for Redwood profile

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ClearCloud is moving quickly through procurement and we need to finish vendor security intake for Redwood to proceed. Can you / your team complete the SIG Lite and CAIQ on our OneTrust portal?

What we need from you:
- OneTrust vendor profile completed (SIG/CAIQ answers saved)
- SOC 2 summary or point-in-time report (redacted OK)
- Evidence links for: encryption at rest, SOC control owner mapping, data retention policy
- Proof of SSO/Okta integration or SAML metadata if available

Target timeline: vendor portal access + initial upload by end of week (Fri 7/24) if possible.

Portal: https://onetrust.vendorportal.com/clearcloud/redwood-profile
Procurement contact: security@clearcloud.com

Appreciate a quick ack and who from your side will own this.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Vendor Security Lead
ClearCloud Media

1) I've sent a OneTrust vendor invite to the portal email you supplied and attached a screenshot of the invite screen (oneTrust-invite-screenshot.png).

Targeting initial uploads by Thu 7/23 EOD — gives you time to review before your Friday deadline. If procurement needs faster, ping me and we'll prioritize.

Thanks Neha / Karthik — this looks great. A few quick clarifications from procurement/security after reviewing your uploads:

1) For SOC 2: can you confirm the reporting period (start/end) and whether your auditor issued any exceptions? A redacted point-in-time report is fine.
2) For retention: our legal team needs the retention schedule for user logs (specifically auth and API access logs). Can you paste the retention table or upload the log retention policy?
3) For SSO: if you have SAML metadata or an Okta integration doc, please upload. If not, a short statement on current SSO state and planned timeline for a formal Okta integration will suffice.

If you can address 1-3 before EOD tomorrow (7/23) that keeps us on track for the purchase order the week after.

Thanks again.
Alex
